title: 据彭博社报道，博通在最新一笔人工智能融资交易中寻求筹集超过600亿美元
content:
Aug 20 (Reuters) - Broadcom is in talks with a group of lenders to raise more than $60 billion in debt for an AI chip financing deal that will benefit Anthropic and other companies, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The financing could include a roughly $30 billion junior debt tranche, while the chip designer would guarantee a part of a senior-secured tranche that could range from about $60 billion to $70 billion, the report said.
The numbers under discussion would potentially bring the total raise to as much as $100 billion, according to the report.
Broadcom plays a crucial role in helping design custom chips for firms like Alphabet and Meta, as tech companies look to develop chips in-house to reduce their reliance on market leader Nvidia. Broadcom also has chip supply deals with Anthropic and OpenAI.
Blackstone and Apollo Global Management are in talks with Broadcom to participate in the financing, the report added.
Blackstone declined to comment, while Broadcom and Apollo did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment on the Bloomberg report.
The potential financing follows a partnership that Broadcom, Apollo and Blackstone struck in June to finance a $35 billion expansion of Anthropic's computing capacity using Broadcom's custom chips and networking solutions.
The initial commitment was expected to add one gigawatt of computing capacity, while the partnership overall aims to enable more than 20 gigawatts of compute power for leading AI labs by 2028.
The new debt would be issued by a special-purpose vehicle and could be similar to the $35 billion agreement, Bloomberg News said.
Tech companies have been increasingly turning to debt markets to fund their costly AI investments. The so-called hyperscalers, including Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft, have signaled that spending on AI will remain elevated through 2026.
(Reporting by Anzar Mehraj in Bengaluru; Editing by Diti Pujara and Leroy Leo)

report.summary: 博通拟融资超600亿美元支持AI芯片交易，惠及Anthropic等。
report.background: 随着生成式AI爆发，科技巨头对算力需求激增，英伟达GPU供不应求，Alphabet、Meta等纷纷转向自研定制芯片。博通作为ASIC设计龙头，成为这些公司的重要合作伙伴，并与Anthropic、OpenAI签有芯片供应协议。今年6月，博通联合黑石、阿波罗为Anthropic提供350亿美元融资扩建计算能力，此次计划中的超600亿美元债务融资规模更大，总潜在规模达1000亿美元，旨在进一步支持AI基础设施建设。同时，科技公司越来越多借助债务市场为高额AI投资输血，预计2026年前支出将持续高涨。
key_points: 博通正与贷款机构谈判，寻求筹集超600亿美元债务，为AI芯片融资交易提供资金，受益方包括Anthropic等，总规模或达1000亿美元。
融资结构复杂，包含约300亿美元次级债务和600-700亿美元高级担保部分，博通将担保后者一部分，以降低风险吸引投资者。
黑石与阿波罗已参与谈判，此前三方曾合作350亿美元为Anthropic扩建算力，如今规模翻倍，显示私募资本对AI基础设施的热情。
此举反映科技公司正加速自研芯片并转向债务市场为AI投资筹资，超大规模企业如Alphabet、亚马逊、微软预计2026年前支出保持高位。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，这笔巨额融资将加速定制芯片和专用算力布局，缓解GPU短缺，推动算力供给多元化，但也会加剧资本开支竞赛。对开发者来说，更多算力资源意味着能训练更大模型，但需适应博通等定制芯片的软件生态，工具链有待成熟。对普通用户，AI服务可能更快、更便宜、更普及，但巨额债务成本最终可能转嫁给消费者，需关注长期服务价格。
report.tools: 可关注OpenAI Triton（GPU/ASIC编程语言）、vLLM（高效推理框架）、Anthropic Claude API（体验前沿模型）。这些工具能帮助开发者了解定制芯片生态下的AI开发模式。
